snippet.title: Evercade Alpha - Time to Change the Game - Trailer
snippet.description:
Change the Game with the Evercade Alpha Bartop Arcade range, the home arcade that's fully compatible with the Evercade physical cartridge ecosystem.

Introducing Evercade Alpha Taito Bartop Arcade - NEW FOR 2025.

Available November 2025
Pre-order May 30th

Special pre-order price: £199.99 | $229.99 | €259.99*
Find out more: https://evercade.co.uk/alpha

The Evercade Alpha allows you to change the game. Available in three officially licensed designs from our partners at the legendary arcade game publishers Capcom and Taito, Evercade Alpha brings a new evolution to the home arcade market. 

Evercade Alpha comes in three variants, the Evercade Alpha Street Fighter™ Bartop Arcade and the Evercade Alpha Mega Man™ Bartop Arcade, with 6-built in arcade games** on each arcade are available now, and the Evercade Alpha Taito Bartop Arcade comes with 10 built-in games.**

*Introductory price available during pre-order period only. Standard SRP will be £229.99 | $279.99 | €249.99 after pre-order period ends.

** Games List:
EVERCADE ALPHA STREET FIGHTER™ BARTOP ARCADE

STREET FIGHTER™ II’ CHAMPION EDITION
SUPER STREET FIGHTER™ II TURBO
SUPER PUZZLE FIGHTER™ II TURBO
STREET FIGHTER™ ALPHA – WARRIORS’ DREAMS -
STREET FIGHTER™ ALPHA 2
STREET FIGHTER™ ALPHA 3

EVERCADE ALPHA MEGAMAN™ BARTOP ARCADE

MEGA MAN™ – THE POWER BATTLE -
MEGA MAN™ 2 – THE POWER FIGHTERS -
CARRIER AIR WING™
FINAL FIGHT™
KNIGHTS OF THE ROUND™
STRIDER™

EVERCADE ALPHA TAITO BARTOP ARCADE

BUBBLE BOBBLE
CADASH
ELEVATOR ACTION
THE FAIRYLAND STORY
GROWL
THE LEGEND OF KAGE
THE NEWZEALAND STORY
PUZZLE BOBBLE
RASTAN
SPACE INVADERS
